summary: Phase 1 starter/workbench split complete: operational assets moved to delivery-workbench; starter kit genericized for sharing.
details:
## Audit
- **Starter kit (template):** CodeGuard rules, generic API samples (Webex/CIRCUIT/Asana/Outlook), docs, comms-bridge MCP scaffold, multi-editor config.
- **Workbench (operational):** Playbooks, email orchestration YAML, M365 connectors, project outputs, personal reference docs.

## Files moved (cp → removed from starter)
| From (starter-kit) | To (delivery-workbench) |
|---|---|
| docs/ServiceFlow SDC/ | docs/reference/serviceflow-sdc/ |
| out/asana-reviews/*.json, *.md | data/asana-reviews/ |
| python/src/agt001_email_chief_of_staff.py | python/integrations/agt001/email_chief_of_staff.py |
| python/src/outlook_action_items.py | python/integrations/agt001/outlook_action_items.py |
| python/examples/agt001_daily_digest_demo.py | scripts/integrations/agt001_daily_digest_demo.py |
| docs/AGENT_FACTORY_*.md, TIGER_TEAM_*.md | docs/reference/agent-factory/ |
| (copy) OUTLOOK_API_ACCESS_GUIDE.md | docs/email/OUTLOOK_AGT001_SETUP.md |

## Starter kit cleanup
- Removed hardcoded paths from comms-bridge MCP (COMMS_DIR required).
- README relationship section added; OUTLOOK guide retargeted to sample (not AGT-001).
- Operational files removed after successful copy.

## Ambiguous (left in starter)
- Asana review **code** (template demo); only review **artifacts** moved.
- dashboard_server.py demo; setup_teamspace_mcp.sh (generic placeholders).

## Docs updated
- MASTER_INDEX.md (#12, #13, overlap map)
- Both READMEs (cross-links)
- MIGRATION_LOG.md (this task)
- delivery-workbench .env.example → you@example.com placeholder

## Self-contained check
- Starter: clone-ready template, no personal paths in comms MCP defaults.
- Workbench: AGT-001 demo via `python3 scripts/integrations/agt001_daily_digest_demo.py`; outputs under data/runs/agt001/.
